description: Present already retrieved source results as source cards when the host supports UI, with a complete readable text list otherwise. Use when the user wants to browse sources or a visual list helps the task. Pass existing results in the desired order; never invent source URLs or factual titles. Does not search, crawl, fetch URLs, verify sources, or consume search credits. Do not call for intermediate research results or when a text answer is sufficient.

results.description: Already retrieved results, in the order to display. No new search is performed.

id.description: The id from the original search result; the server falls back to the URL when there is none

metadata.description: Metadata from the original result, such as the publication date; never credentials or UI details

text.description: Snippet or faithful excerpt from the source, not a full page or a model-written answer

title.description: Source title exactly as the search returned it; never invent or rewrite it

url.description: Link to the source as the search returned it, never one carrying credentials

title.description: Heading shown above the cards, such as the research topic
